name: dftracer_provenance_graph
description: dftracer provenance mode, graph stage: build the provenance graph from <WS>/provenance/traces with provenance_extract_graph (dftracer-utils dftracer_view, indexed), write graph.json/graph.dot, apply the health gate (no dangling hashes, every type described, every artifact produced and rooted in a spec input) and map any gap back to a concrete annotation fix; then the reproduction package final_provenance/ and isolated-run verification. Load after the provenance traced run, or on 'healthy: false', prov_events 0, dangling_hashes, types_undescribed, artifact_types_missing, artifacts_without_producer, truncated_activities, 'dftracer_view failed', or a graph with activities but zero entities.
